insights.concise_text: Combining CNN and RNN models with a voting process achieves an F1 score of 84.9 on the SemEval 2010 task 8 test set, better than either NN type alone.

triple.subject: voting combination of CNN and RNN models
triple.object: the two NN types alone with an F1 score of 84.9

insights.concise_text: The simple voting scheme that combines CNNs and RNNs is the ensemble voting process used to report ensemble results.

triple.subject: simple voting scheme
triple.object: voting process for ensemble results

insights.concise_text: The ranking loss function introduced for RNN model optimization is applied to train the models and maximizes distance between the true label INLINEFORM0 and the best competitive label INLINEFORM1.

triple.subject: ranking loss function
triple.object: maximizing distance between the true label INLINEFORM0 and the best competitive label INLINEFORM1

insights.concise_text: The ranking layer whose integration has a large impact on RNN performance corresponds to the ranking loss function applied to train the models.

triple.subject: ranking layer
triple.object: ranking loss function

insights.concise_text: The extended middle context addresses the max-pooling risk of choosing values far from the relation mention by splitting context into two parts and repeating the middle context.

triple.subject: extended middle context
triple.object: max-pooling choices far from the relation mention

insights.concise_text: Connectionist bi-directional RNN models combine all intermediate hidden layers for their final decision by adding a connection to the previous combined hidden layer.

triple.subject: connectionist bi-directional RNN models
triple.object: a connection to the previous combined hidden layer

insights.concise_text: The additional hidden layer connections that have a large impact on RNN performance are the feature defining connectionist bi-directional RNNs.

triple.subject: additional hidden layer connections
triple.object: connectionist bi-directional RNNs

insights.concise_text: The CNN and RNN models combined by voting were evaluated with the official scoring script using macro F1 score on 2,717 test sentences.

triple.subject: voting combination of CNN and RNN models
triple.object: 2,717 test sentences with macro F1 score

insights.concise_text: The claim that combining CNNs and RNNs achieves new state-of-the-art results is supported by the voting combination achieving an F1 score of 84.9.

triple.subject: voting combination achieving an F1 score of 84.9
triple.object: new state-of-the-art results on the SemEval 2010 benchmark dataset

insights.concise_text: The complementary-information explanation for the voting combination is that the RNN computes a weighted combination of all words while the CNN extracts the most informative n-grams.

triple.subject: voting combination of CNN and RNN models
triple.object: complementary information from all words and most informative n-grams
